mapper.sql: id, name, source_data_source_id, source_schema, source_table, source_kafka_servers, target_type, target_data_source_id, target_schema, target_table, enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdc_mapping (name, source_data_source_id, source_schema, source_table, source_kafka_servers, target_type, target_data_source_id, target_schema, target_table, enabled) VALUES (#{name}, #{sourceDataSourceId}, #{sourceSchema}, #{sourceTable}, #{sourceKafkaServers}, #{targetType}, #{targetDataSourceId}, #{targetSchema}, #{targetTable}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE cdc_mapping SET name = #{name}, source_data_source_id = #{sourceDataSourceId}, source_schema = #{sourceSchema}, source_table = #{sourceTable}, source_kafka_servers = #{sourceKafkaServers}, target_type = #{targetType}, target_data_source_id = #{targetDataSourceId}, target_schema = #{targetSchema}, target_table = #{targetTable}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}

where.if: (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR source_table LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR target_table LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM cdc_mapping WHERE enabled = 1 AND source_data_source_id IS NOT NULL AND source_table IS NOT NULL AND source_table != '' ORDER BY id ASC
